(a) a frame from a top-budget film, a AAA game cinematic or a cinema nature documentary, (b) a stock photograph, (c) a seed catalog or textbook picture, (d) amateur generated art, (e) a real-time web 3D demo. Answer with one letter, a confidence from 0 to 100, and the one thing that most influenced your answer.
